title: simple_example_03_route_choice_bus_network
description: Larger synthetic public-transportation example with five bus lines, a three-hour morning horizon, and several OD pairs with multiple plausible routes. The network is designed so that route choice and the assignment dispersion parameter affect boarding and alighting measurements.

route_choice_features: A-H can use L3 direct or L1/L4/L2 via C/E/F with transfers.
A-F can use L3 direct or L1 plus L4 via C/E.
N-H can use L5 plus L2, or L5 plus L4 plus L2 depending on departure time.
B-G can use L2/L4/L1 via D/E, or L3/L1 via A/C depending on direction and timing.
